# opnsense_proxy_pac_proxy (Data Source)

Proxies offered to clients by the proxy auto-config file (**Services ▸ Squid Web Proxy ▸ Proxy Auto Config ▸ Proxies**).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the PAC proxy.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `name` (String) Name of the proxy.
- `proxy_type` (String) Proxy type written to the PAC file.
- `url` (String) Proxy as `host:port`. Not used with `DIRECT`.
